tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background: a warm off-white, never pure white.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, the composer, call cards, menus and inputs.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Agent chat bubbles, inline code, quiet wells and panels behind product shots.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and card edges. In dark, cards lean on this because shadows barely show.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that carry meaning: inputs and outlined controls. At least 3:1 on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text and headings, on every surface and every tint.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: ledes, captions, labels, metadata. Passes 4.5:1 on every surface and tint.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: The welldun orange. Display text at 24px and up, the wordmark dot, waveforms and other decoration. Not for small text in light mode (3.4:1).

tokens.name: signal-strong
tokens.usage: Orange at text strength: links, small accent text, filled accent buttons with on-signal text.

tokens.name: signal-soft
tokens.usage: Orange tint behind callouts and highlighted rows.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a signal-strong fill.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links in running text, underlined.

tokens.name: caller
tokens.usage: The other person on a call: their chat bubbles. Blue so the two voices never look alike.

tokens.name: on-caller
tokens.usage: Text on caller bubbles.

tokens.name: tint-peach
tokens.usage: Category card and chip ground (recruiting). Text in ink or ink-muted.

tokens.name: tint-blue
tokens.usage: Category card and chip ground (front desk).

tokens.name: tint-mint
tokens.usage: Category card and chip ground (sales).

tokens.name: tint-lavender
tokens.usage: Category card and chip ground (spare).

tokens.name: tint-yellow
tokens.usage: Category card and chip ground (spare).

tokens.name: avatar-peach
tokens.usage: Avatar circle behind initials, paired with tint-peach.

tokens.name: avatar-blue
tokens.usage: Avatar circle, paired with tint-blue.

tokens.name: avatar-mint
tokens.usage: Avatar circle, paired with tint-mint.

tokens.name: avatar-lavender
tokens.usage: Avatar circle, paired with tint-lavender.

tokens.name: avatar-yellow
tokens.usage: Avatar circle, paired with tint-yellow.

tokens.name: code-bg
tokens.usage: Code block ground. Dark in both themes.

tokens.name: code-ink
tokens.usage: Code text on code-bg.

tokens.name: code-muted
tokens.usage: Comments and punctuation on code-bg.

tokens.name: code-signal
tokens.usage: Strings, the shell prompt and the active tab on code-bg.

tokens.name: code-border
tokens.usage: Code block edge: invisible in light, a hairline in dark.

tokens.name: status-queued
tokens.usage: Call state queued: text and dot, on status-queued-soft or the surfaces.

tokens.name: status-queued-soft
tokens.usage: Pill ground for queued.

tokens.name: status-dialing
tokens.usage: Call state dialing (ochre, kept apart from signal).

tokens.name: status-dialing-soft
tokens.usage: Pill ground for dialing.

tokens.name: status-live
tokens.usage: Call state in_progress: a live call. Green, like an active line.

tokens.name: status-live-soft
tokens.usage: Pill ground for in_progress.

tokens.name: status-done
tokens.usage: Call state completed and other success. Blue-leaning so it never relies on red/green against failed.

tokens.name: status-done-soft
tokens.usage: Pill ground for completed.

tokens.name: status-failed
tokens.usage: Call state failed and errors. Always paired with the word.

tokens.name: status-failed-soft
tokens.usage: Pill ground for failed; error callouts.

tokens.name: card-border
tokens.usage: Card edge: invisible in light (the shadow does the work), a hairline in dark.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

styles.name: display-xl
styles.sample: Describe the call. Offhook makes it.
styles.usage: One per page: the hero headline. 44px on phones.

styles.name: display-md
styles.sample: From a sentence to a finished call

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: h2 in articles and docs; card titles.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: h3, small card titles, dialog titles.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Tell Offhook who to call and what you need to find out.
styles.usage: Ledes and article deks, in ink-muted.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Every time the caller finishes speaking, the agent runs a relay race.
styles.usage: Running text. Keep lines near 68 characters.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Set VOICE_DEBUG_LOGGING=1 to log per-stage latency.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Small sentence-case labels above values and sections, in ink-muted. Never uppercase.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code blocks, inline code, field keys and API values only.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Timestamps, durations and IDs that line up. Use tabular figures.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, the dot inside a status pill.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps between pills, buttons in a row, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control inner padding (vertical x horizontal 8 x 14 uses space-2 / 14px), gaps in nav.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Minimum page gutter on phones; card inner padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card inner padding; gap between paragraphs and blocks in an article.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page gutter on desktop; gap between a headline group and its content.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap before an article h2; between page sections on phones.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between page sections on desktop.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Hero top padding on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inline code, small tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, small cards, result tiles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, the composer, call cards, code blocks.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Large panels behind product shots and category cards.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, status pills, avatars.

shadow.note: Soft, warm shadows lift cards off the page in light. In dark they barely show, so cards also get card-border.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards, the composer, call cards, result tiles.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, the sticky header after scroll.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Max width of running text in articles and docs.

tokens.name: page-max
tokens.usage: Max width of page content, gutters excluded.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Site header height.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs at the default size; 34px at sm.
